human_name: Y chromosome palindrome P4 (AZFb, RBMY1 cluster)

GRCh38.note: Approximate — Rhie 2023 states P4-P8 are concordant between GRCh38-Y and T2T-Y in arm/spacer lengths and identity (99.84-99.96%). Coordinate match expected ~ ±200 kb.

CHM13.note: T2T-CHM13 v2.0/Y v1 — P4-left-arm 19356702-19546840 (190138 bp), P4-right-arm 19586496-19776671 (190175 bp), spacer 19546840-19586496 (~40 kb). Source: chm13v2.0Y_inverted_repeats_v1.bed (marbl).

architecture_note: Nested in X-degenerate context (Rhie 2023). One of the symmetric palindromes — arms differ by only 37 bp.

primary.note: Identity 99.98% (highest of P1-P5 in Skaletsky Table 3) — mm=1 sufficient. Spacer ~40 kb.

fallback_chain.name: spacer_anchor
fallback_chain.trigger: primary returns ambiguous chains across both arms
fallback_chain.rationale: P4 spacer ~40 kb — moderate; HiFi reads ≥20 kb often span partial spacer

fallback_chain.name: flanking_anchor
fallback_chain.rationale: anchor to P3-P4 or P4-P5 boundary

primary_sources.note: Skaletsky H et al., Nature. Table 3: P4 arm 190 kb, spacer 40 kb, identity 99.98%, total 419 kb.
Rozen S et al., Nature. Arm-to-arm gene conversion in P4.
Rhie A et al., Nature. P4-P8 concordant between GRCh38-Y and T2T-Y, arm-to-arm identity 99.84-99.96% in T2T-Y. Coordinate match expected.
